verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Superhuman blog post titled "how to use team comments". It describes @mentioning teammates, sharing live email views, and coordinating responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions. However, the quoted text is framed generically ("the best email collaboration tools let you…") rather than as a clearly documented Superhuman feature. Team read statuses and reply indicators are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs confirming Superhuman ships internal comment threads beside a message, details of how @mention notifications work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
